content:
q11.
APIV1Service.CreateMemo — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go

Only one API-layer (non-test) handler calls the store method: `s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:115`, inside `func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemo` (declared at line 70).

Related, so it isn't mistaken for a second store caller: `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20`) reaches the store only indirectly — it calls the API-level `s.CreateMemo(...)` at line 56. The remaining `Store.CreateMemo` call sites are tests (`server/router/api/v1/test/memo_service_test.go:597`, `server/router/api/v1/test/memo_service_benchmark_test.go:117,164`), and `ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:306`) is a transport shim delegating to `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`.
